d:
Powerful rap about ambition, struggle, and hustle. The artist reflects on creating a legacy, navigating challenges, and staying true to their craft. With sharp wordplay, the verses touch on rising above obstacles, embracing street culture, and achieving success without compromising values. The hook reinforces a dynamic, unstoppable lifestyle, combining determination with artistic mastery.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Married To The Game
Written & Performed By: Siyaahi
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Siyaahi
Track Name: Married To The Game
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Siyaahi
